meta.name: Kumudini Bhavan
meta.description:
A mysterious death at Kumudini Bhavan stuns Inspector Hochi and Anushree, the newest resident at the women's hostel. As they team up and dig deep, they discover unsettling secrets and unforeseen ties, with more deaths creeping up on them!

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Jonmodinei Mrityu
videos.overview: A sudden death at Kumudini Bhavan casts a shadow of mourning on everyone. As police officer Hochi arrives for investigation, he meets the eccentric Anushree.

videos.title: Dwitiyo Mrityu
videos.overview: As everyone begins to suspect Swatilekha Devi's grandson post interrogation, Anushree helps the police discover another body.

videos.title: Tritiyo Mrityu
videos.overview: From Janhabi to Rwik, everyone in the hostel seems to be in two minds. In the middle of the investigation, another surprising death further complicates things.

videos.title: Sutro
videos.overview: On Anushree's insistence, the police starts probing about a suspicious headphone found at one of the crime scenes. Amidst Rwik's treatment, the police suspects a person close to them.

videos.title: Ami Durbake Marini
videos.overview: Although the police nabs the culprit behind the subsequent murders, Durba's killer is still at large. Meanwhile, Anushree learns about Raya who had the same fate as Durba.

videos.title: Dwitiyo Sutro
videos.overview: Investigation reveals that the deaths of Durba and Raya had a pattern. The poison found in Durba's body stuns Hochi and Anushree who are desperate to unmask the killer.

videos.title: Rakshak e Bhakshak
videos.overview: Anushree realizes the killer might be hiding in plain sight at Kumudini Bhavan. But the killer plots to kill Anushree herself to sweep everything under the rug!
